text: {"lessons":["I bought Stock A and Stock D at higher prices, then sold them at losses; I should set a clear thesis and review conditions before buying, rather than let entry price or short-term fear dictate the exit.","Adding to Stock E and later selling it at a gain did not by itself show good timing; I should base trades on a reasoned view of risk and value, not treat a realized gain as proof the decision was sound.","My account rose overall but also had sharp monthly swings; I should keep position sizes and cash reserves appropriate to my risk tolerance, and assess performance over time against a market benchmark."]}
